about.title: About ONG AICHA
story: The Active Islamic Charitable Humanitarian Association (AICHA) was founded in 2019 by a group of young Muslims from a variety of professions. Seeing how little social support reached the most disadvantaged in Côte d'Ivoire, they decided to put their skills at the service of others, regardless of race or origin.

Its founding members came together spontaneously and as volunteers, driven by a spirit of solidarity and self-giving for the well-being of others, core values of Islam. Their work covers health, humanitarian aid, social well-being and education, with vulnerable populations as the priority.
Since April 2021, the NGO's headquarters have been in Port-Bouët, Abidjan.
objectives: To support children in difficulty and their families in the areas of health, education, humanitarian aid and social well-being.
To run awareness campaigns against all diseases.
To come to the rescue of any child or community in distress.
about.funding: Our activities are funded by member contributions and by donations, in kind or in cash, from generous individuals as well as senior public figures.
about.leadership: The Central Executive Director is Pr Kourouma Hamdan Sarah, supported by a dynamic Executive Board.

timeline.title: Founding of the association
timeline.text: A group of young Muslims from a range of professions founds AICHA to support the most disadvantaged in Côte d'Ivoire.

timeline.title: Headquarters in Port-Bouët
timeline.text: Since April 2021, the NGO's headquarters have been based in Port-Bouët, Abidjan.

timeline.title: The Pink and Red Wave in Grand-Bassam
timeline.text: 4th edition: more than 500 women screened for breast cancer and more than 600 people tested for diabetes and hypertension, along with a blood drive.

timeline.title: Launch of the Mobile Clinics
timeline.text: Free consultations with specialist doctors, in the heart of underserved neighborhoods.

timeline.title: New clothes for Tabaski
timeline.text: Food and new clothes for 300 orphans and 50 widows in the Abidjan district.

timeline.title: Ramadan Food Baskets: 6th edition
timeline.text: 710 vulnerable families and individuals assisted across several communes of Abidjan.

timeline.title: On the Way to School
timeline.text: 160 vulnerable children equipped for the new school year, and the annual school fees of 10 secondary school students covered.

timeline.title: Pink and Red Wave Caravan in Port-Bouët
timeline.text: On 4 October 2025: screenings, HPV vaccination for young girls and awareness-raising.

faq.q: What are my donations used for?
faq.a: They fund the field work of ONG AICHA: health, education, humanitarian aid and social welfare for the most vulnerable.

faq.q: Can I choose which program I support?
faq.a: Yes. In the form, you choose the program you wish to support, or "where the need is greatest".
Yes, select "Zakat" from the list. If you have any questions, please contact us before giving.

faq.q: Can I make an in-kind donation?
faq.a: Yes. Drop it off at our headquarters in Port-Bouët Abattoir, or contact us and we will come to collect it.
Payment is processed by PayDunya (Orange Money, MTN, Moov, Wave, bank cards). ONG AICHA does not store any banking data.

legal.title: Legal notice
body: This website is published by ONG AICHA – Active Islamic Charitable Humanitarian Association, whose headquarters are located at Port-Bouët Abattoir, Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire.

Personal data: the information collected through the forms (donations, sponsorship, membership, contact) is used solely to process your request and is never resold. Payments are processed by PayDunya; ONG AICHA does not store any banking data. To exercise your rights of access, rectification or deletion, write to us at ongaicha2022@gmail.com.
